_comment: AllowedOrigins is '*' by necessity: the admin UI that performs uploads is served from the platform domain AND from every tenant's own portal.<their-domain> hostname, which are arbitrary customer domains that cannot be enumerated ahead of time. This is not the security boundary - the presigned PUT URL is. It is issued only to an authenticated admin (POST /api/uploads/request-url requires a session), expires in 15 minutes, is bound to a single object key, and is bound to an allow-listed Content-Type. CORS here only governs which page may initiate the browser PUT.
